purpose: Knowledge-gated, audience-specific, deterministic social reputation. Reputation changes expectations and access through observers and institutions; it never grants magical knowledge or direct combat stats.

scale.unknown: absence of a profile/axis is unknown, not 50

standing_axes.renown: recognition for meaningful achievement inside a relevant professional/social audience
standing_axes.fame: public recognition inside an audience; not a global omniscient score
standing_axes.prestige: status/esteem that the audience assigns from known achievement, office, pedigree, honor, patronage, wealth, or institutional standing
standing_axes.notoriety: recognition driven by danger, controversy, disruption, criminality, scandal, or feared conduct; not automatically moral condemnation
standing_axes.infamy: strongly negative notoriety: hatred, stigma, or moral condemnation inside that audience

profile_rule: Every standing/dimension value belongs to one subject+audience pair. No universal reputation vector exists.

knowledge_gate.relationship_is_separate: A person may dislike a respected subject or love someone they consider incompetent. Relationship state never substitutes for reputation evidence.
knowledge_gate.institutional_fact_rule: Known rank, office, title, uniform, banner, seal, affiliation, or public appointment may affect treatment as an observed fact without inventing a reputation score.

evidence_update.effective_weight_formula: round(base_weight * source_reliability/100 * clarity/100 * channel_integrity/100 * audience_relevance/100 * corroboration/100)
evidence_update.new_axis_rule: If an axis has no prior evidence and effective_weight>0, set score=signal_score and mass=effective_weight.
evidence_update.zero_weight_rule: Zero effective weight creates no profile change.

corroboration.rule: Corroboration above 100 increases evidence weight but never bypasses audience access or knowledge routes.

propagation.duplicate_delivery_rule: The same delivery key may update a subject+audience profile at most once.
propagation.chronology_rule: Reports affect an audience only after the route physically/institutionally reaches that audience. Use existing message/travel/faction/institution clocks rather than a duplicate reputation-only global clock.
propagation.distortion_rule: A report may carry a transformed signal only when the source has saved bias, incentives, error, censorship, propaganda, or incomplete observation. Preserve the original event separately.

decay.settlement: lazy exact-time settlement is allowed when no intervening report/update exists; active report travel uses existing process coverage
decay.toward: standing recognition trends toward 0 when forgotten; descriptive dimension scores retain their last direction while confidence/evidence mass decays
decay.title_office_rule: Current office/title effects come from current institutional facts, not immortalized reputation memory.

effects.context_rule: Any mechanical consequence must cite the relevant audience profile plus the domain rule that makes that reputation relevant. Reputation is not a universal percentage bonus.

history_rule: Current audience profiles are authoritative current state. Reputation events are cold causal history. Do not load event history unless explaining provenance, propagating an undelivered report, or auditing a change.
